content:

The mixed equity tape, with the S&P 500 up 1.0%, Nasdaq 100 only +0.84%, and the VIX steady near 18, suggests the market is tentatively absorbing this risk without broad panic yet. We maintain a cautious-bearish stance on Tyler Technologies near $340, anticipating further pressure on valuation absent a clear turnaround. This view changes if Q2 guidance shows revenue growth accelerating above 7% or margin expansion exceeding 30 basis points, which would signal a sustainable recovery in contract wins and cost control. Until then, the risk of multiple compression remains elevated, with spillover implications for growth software benchmarks and related tech equities.
